messages:
Maya: rolling v6.1.0 now. deploy-bot just bubbled up increased stream resets on hosted canary. dropping into this channel for a quick ops call.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] hosted-canary / stream-reset-rate = 0.7% (baseline 0.05%) threshold 0.3% -> recommend auto-revert to v6.0.9.

Omar: I see `grpc: stream error: WINDOW_UPDATE` in the traces from edge-02. Dedicated/private look clean.

Priya: we have an org change freeze in 90m; auto-revert for all could collide with legal notifications. prefer limiting blast radius.

Gwen: propose scoped mitigation: pin hosted-edge to prior image and route hosted traffic to that image. avoids touching dedicated pools.

Ravi: agree. minimal rollback for hosted only. who will run the pin and routing?

Maya: I can run the kubectl pin. Omar can do the routing step. Priya draft a short customer line.

Omar: routing command (rlctl): `rlctl route steer --name hosted-api --tag hosted-stable-610 --weight 100` will move hosted traffic. Do it in 3 steps 25/60/100.

Maya: kubectl: `kubectl -n edge set image deploy/edge ingress=redwood/edge:6.0.9 --record` then watch rollout. I'll start now.

Priya: draft note: "We've observed streaming resets on the Hosted API after v6.1.0. We've reverted the Hosted edge to the previous stable image to restore service. No action required from customers. Dedicated and Private deployments unaffected." ok to post?

Gwen: 👍 please post after we confirm metrics. Maya, status?

Maya: image pinned, rollout in progress: 1/3 -> 3/3 ready. Omar you can start traffic steer.

Omar: steering 25% -> health ok -> 60% -> ok -> 100% applied. deploy-bot: metrics trending back to baseline.

deploy-bot: [INFO] hosted-edge pinned to 6.0.9, stream-reset-rate returned to 0.04% within 90s.

Priya: posted customer blurb to /customers/hosted-updates: https://customers.redwood/status/hosted-streams-rollback-2024. Created follow-up ticket INFRA-6210 "Review grpc windowing change in edge" and assigned to @networking.

Maya: thanks team. leaving thread open until release_notes updated. will close after that. :white_check_mark:
